Elise Nieshalla

Republican candidate for State Comptroller (Auditor of State), Indiana · Incumbent

Indiana State Comptroller (incumbent)

Elise Nieshalla is the Republican incumbent Indiana State Comptroller (the office formally called Auditor of State). She took office on December 1, 2023, after Gov. Eric Holcomb appointed her to succeed Tera Klutz. She won the Republican nomination at the state party convention and faces Democrat Jessica Bailey and Libertarian John Schick in the November 3, 2026 general election.

Where Nieshalla stands

Priorities for the office
Lists her top priorities as responsible fiscal policy, continued transparency on government spending, and smooth distribution of tax revenue to local governments.
Reason for running
Says she is running to keep Indiana financially strong, transparent, responsible and disciplined. She notes the office handles state accounting, reporting, payroll and vendor payments.
National debt
Calls for action on the national debt and points to Indiana's balanced budget amendment as a model for the federal government.
State Board of Finance transparency
Says State Board of Finance members review information before meetings to make sure it is 'on the up and up.'
